name: AI/BI Customer Support: AI Efficiency
narrative:
You're the VP of Customer Support at a global travel company, reviewing how 2025 went. For years resolution time and cost per case sat stubbornly high — then mid-year something shifted: average resolution dropped from ~26 hours to ~11, cost per case roughly halved, and satisfaction ticked up.

The dashboard shows the turn clearly; ask Genie why and it traces it to the AI Support Copilot going GA on June 2, 2025 — auto-resolving How-To, Access and Billing cases so people can focus on the hard ones. You can ask which region is slowest (APAC) and how much cost fell, all in plain English.
